scrub_secrets_from_string: create a SecretScrubber instance and call scrub on a string to redact AWS keys and tokens
get_scrub_report: call get_report on a ScrubSummary object to get a text summary of substitutions made
scrub_log_messages: use LoggingSecretScrubber as a logging formatter to automatically scrub secrets from log output
review_secret_patterns: review the SecretScrubber SECRETS list to see which regex patterns detect AWS keys and Meta tokens
add_custom_secret_pattern: refactor the SecretScrubber SECRETS list to add a new Secret with a custom regex pattern
